workItem.objective: Implement capability-oriented release adapter slots and consolidated explicit approval for every proposed external or privileged effect.

included: Provider-neutral materialize, inspect, verify, attest, and publication-prerequisite-probe manifests.
Exact versions, configurations, grants, maturity, execution receipts, failure dispositions, and substitution protection.
One compact pre-effect review for network, signing, credential, filesystem, process, tag, and remote-repository effects.
excluded: Tool-specific Core routing, silent fallback, implicit credentials, publication, tags, deployment, or support claims without live receipts.

deliverables.description: Release adapter SDK, manifests, bounded host executors, approval summary, conformance suite, and maturity records.

dependency-hints.rationale: Adapters are bounded by finalized request and receipt contracts.
Optional capabilities must conform to native candidate and checkpoint semantics.

checks.method: Run fixture, unavailable, malformed-output, provider-substitution, undeclared-effect, grant-escalation, secret, network, fallback, replay, and live-maturity matrices.
checks.successCriteria: Adapters remain swappable and untrusted, every effect is explicit before execution, and maturity claims exactly match archived evidence.

required-evidence.description: Adapters remain swappable and untrusted, every effect is explicit before execution, and maturity claims exactly match archived evidence.

workItem.objective: Implement closed release candidate, verification, readiness, policy, evidence, checkpoint, and traceability artifacts with strict validators.

included: Canonical schemas and validators for all five RP interface intents.
Exact candidate, attempt, artifact, obligation, result, Gate, checkpoint, and evidence semantics.
Malformed, stale, substituted, additional-property, secret, and digest-drift fixtures.
excluded: Adapter-owned Gate, owner-decision, publication, or TraceabilityGraph authority.

deliverables.description: RP-001 schemas, validators, exports, and conformance fixtures.

checks.method: Validate positive artifacts and exhaustive malformed, stale, substituted, additional-property, secret, authority, and digest-mismatch fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Every RP artifact validates only under its exact closed contract and no adapter can assert Gate, owner, publication, or graph authority.

required-evidence.description: Every RP artifact validates only under its exact closed contract and no adapter can assert Gate, owner, publication, or graph authority.

workItem.objective: Implement the Core-owned ReleaseVerificationGate and one compact evidence-linked readiness summary before BusinessAcceptance.

included: Closed Gate outcomes and exact candidate, source, baseline, environment, policy, maturity, evidence, replay, and owner-intent bindings.
Blocker, warning, identity, artifact digest, obligation coverage, effect, and evidence-link projection.
Gate-owned ReleaseReadinessBaseline authorizing only human-controlled publication consideration.
excluded: Publication, deployment, tagging, protected-main mutation, changelog approval, stable designation, or final release approval.

deliverables.description: ReleaseVerificationGate, readiness baseline, policy dispositions, compact Desktop summary, and routing diagnostics.

dependency-hints.rationale: The Gate consumes obligation-complete stored-byte verification.
The Gate and summary must expose exact adapter maturity and proposed-effect dispositions.

checks.method: Test every Gate outcome, owner and policy truth table, stale evidence, maturity mismatch, drift, substitution, replay, no-publication boundary, and compact-summary parity.
checks.successCriteria: Only the Gate promotes readiness for downstream consideration, all blockers are visible, and no successful outcome performs or implies publication.

required-evidence.description: Only the Gate promotes readiness for downstream consideration, all blockers are visible, and no successful outcome performs or implies publication.

workItem.objective: Implement conditional lifecycle routing and one immutable release-candidate identity bound to exact approved state and current environment readiness.

included: Post-SystemVerification conditional routing and pre-BusinessAcceptance Gate routing.
Exact source commit and tree, baselines, version, configuration, policy, toolchain, owner intent, and EnvironmentReadinessReceipt binding.
Drift, ambiguity, stale readiness, and unsupported-scope diagnostics.
excluded: Inferring version, changelog approval, prerelease designation, publication approval, or downstream acceptance.

deliverables.description: Release operation router, candidate identity resolver, drift guards, and lifecycle fixtures.

dependency-hints.rationale: Identity and routing must emit the finalized RP contracts.

checks.method: Run route, identity, stale-readiness, owner-intent, source, version, baseline, policy, toolchain, configuration, drift, and unsupported-scope matrices.
checks.successCriteria: Core alone selects the declared route and produces one immutable, fully bound attempt without inferring owner decisions.

required-evidence.description: Core alone selects the declared route and produces one immutable, fully bound attempt without inferring owner decisions.

workItem.objective: Implement deterministic native Node and Windows materialization of the exact installable release candidate and supporting artifacts.

included: Package cataloging, packing, CycloneDX SBOM, SHA-256 ledger, release notes, legal material, and evidence index.
Project-local checksum-pinned tools, content-addressed storage, exact commands, bytes, versions, durations, and checkpoints.
GitHub source-identity verification without predicting hosted archive bytes.
excluded: Publishing to npm or GitHub, creating or pushing tags, signing with real credentials, deployment, or protected-main mutation.

deliverables.description: Native release materializer, artifact store, package catalog, SBOM, checksum ledger, and raw receipts.

dependency-hints.rationale: Materialization requires one exact approved attempt identity.

checks.method: Run deterministic pack, repeated-byte, SBOM, checksum, catalog, legal, evidence-index, offline, clean-path, crash, and zero-effect replay matrices.
checks.successCriteria: The native adapter produces the complete exact candidate set reproducibly, checkpoints it before progression, and performs no publication effect.

required-evidence.description: The native adapter produces the complete exact candidate set reproducibly, checkpoints it before progression, and performs no publication effect.

workItem.objective: Add exhaustive deterministic, security, policy, permission, recovery, byte-substitution, telemetry, and transition-safe release regression coverage.

included: Property, mutation, negative, permission, secret, network, path, crash, replay, policy, graph, package, and installed-consumer matrices.
Bounded parallel read-only checks and serialized or isolated materialization effects.
Durations, retries, cache hits, artifact sizes, command fingerprints, and bottleneck receipts without a universal wall-clock SLA.
excluded: Weakening fail-closed behavior, mutating historical release evidence, or claiming unsupported hosted interoperability.

deliverables.description: RP-001 complete regression, security, policy, recovery, substitution, concurrency, telemetry, and release-gate suites.

dependency-hints.rationale: The full gate includes trusted candidate and approved graph behavior.
The full matrix verifies final Gate and summary semantics.

checks.method: Run focused, mutation, supply-chain, permission, secret, crash, drift, substitution, concurrency, repeatability, telemetry, canonical verify, catalog, pack, and installed-package suites.
checks.successCriteria: All RP failure modes and authority boundaries are covered, deterministic repeats match, telemetry is complete, and every prior release gate remains green.

required-evidence.description: All RP failure modes and authority boundaries are covered, deterministic repeats match, telemetry is complete, and every prior release gate remains green.

workItem.objective: Implement trusted forward traceability from approved source and environment state through candidate bytes, verification evidence, and Gate readiness.

included: Separate candidate and approved scopes with deterministic forward vocabulary.
Adapter isolation, endpoint validation, checkpoint-before-merge, replay, merge proof, provenance queries, and orphan diagnostics.
Impact and coverage queries over exact candidate identity and evidence.
excluded: Adapter-authored graph operations, arbitrary edge kinds, stored inverse edges, or promotion without Gate authority.

deliverables.description: Release traceability contributor, queries, updates, checkpoints, merge proofs, and diagnostics.

dependency-hints.rationale: The contributor requires finalized candidate, readiness, and trace contracts.

checks.method: Validate forward vocabulary, candidate and approved scope isolation, source closure, unknown endpoints, atomic merge, replay, orphan detection, coverage, impact, and provenance queries.
checks.successCriteria: Every release decision is reconstructable while adapters remain graph-blind and candidate facts never gain approved authority implicitly.

required-evidence.description: Every release decision is reconstructable while adapters remain graph-blind and candidate facts never gain approved authority implicitly.

workItem.objective: Implement exact stored-byte release verification against one complete versioned release and supply-chain policy.

included: Reload exact content-addressed candidate bytes without rebuilding or normalization.
Static checks, complete tests, exports, isolated install and import, SBOM, checksums, docs, secrets, and Windows consumer obligations.
Required, failed, missing, stale, unknown, and policy-backed ApprovedNotApplicable truth tables.
excluded: Self-certification by an adapter, inferred not-applicable status, rebuilt artifacts, or verification of a different candidate.

deliverables.description: Stored-byte verifier, obligation expander, policy engine, verification adapters, and evidence normalizer.

dependency-hints.rationale: Verification must consume exact prepared candidate bytes.

checks.method: Exercise complete obligation, not-applicable, policy drift, dependency, action pin, license, provenance, SBOM, checksum, secret, substitution, truncation, and installed-package matrices.
checks.successCriteria: Every required obligation is evaluated against exact stored bytes and any missing, failed, stale, unknown, or substituted evidence blocks readiness.

required-evidence.description: Every required obligation is evaluated against exact stored bytes and any missing, failed, stale, unknown, or substituted evidence blocks readiness.

workItem.objective: Prove ReleasePreparation and ReleaseVerification end to end in a clean ChatGPT/Codex Desktop Windows run using the packed DevRelay library without publishing.

included: Load current memory and baselines, prove environment readiness, route from SystemVerification, bind one candidate, and materialize the complete candidate set.
Reload stored bytes, verify every obligation, produce the compact Gate package, replay with zero effects, and reject induced drift and substitution.
Archive commands, versions, grants, effects, artifacts, checkpoints, policy, evidence, traceability, installed-consumer, and no-publication proof.
excluded: Public npm, hosted release creation, tag creation or push, deployment, protected-main mutation, one-click Desktop installation, or non-Windows claims.

deliverables.description: Clean Windows Desktop release-preparation dogfood, exact candidate, evidence, lifecycle report, no-publication proof, milestone, and acceptance package.

dependency-hints.rationale: The release-defining Desktop run requires the complete green regression and security gate.

checks.method: Run the installed package through readiness, identity, materialization, stored-byte verification, Gate summary, checkpoint replay, induced drift, substitution rejection, recovery, trace queries, and explicit no-publication checks.
checks.successCriteria: A Windows Desktop user can prepare and prove one exact release candidate, recover and replay deterministically, trace every decision and artifact, and reach Gate readiness without publishing.

required-evidence.description: A Windows Desktop user can prepare and prove one exact release candidate, recover and replay deterministically, trace every decision and artifact, and reach Gate readiness without publishing.
